findings.element: Summary settings → Sales recording date card description (proposed copy)
findings.finding: The description says Payment date removes Accounts Receivable from summaries. The spec has no source for this, and the same page offers "Sync open invoices", which exists to account for unpaid invoices (AR), so the claim is unverified and may be false for orgs that enable it.
findings.user_impact: A bookkeeper who picks Payment date, expects no AR and then finds an AR balance from open invoices may treat it as an error and reverse entries, or may skip reconciling AR altogether.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the AR behaviour with the spec owner, including the case where Sync open invoices is enabled. Keep the sentence only if it holds in every case; otherwise state the condition or remove it.

evidence.quote: With Payment date there is no Accounts Receivable in summaries.
evidence.source: Domain validator scope: unsourced product logic must be reported as unverified. context.md product facts have no AR statement for Sales recording date. The state map shows a "Sync open invoices … account for unpaid (open) invoices" setting on the same page.

findings.element: Invoices tab → Invoice date lock note (Schedule start = Invoice created date)
findings.finding: The lock note says schedules start "from the invoice date". That is the exact RevRec label the spec renames to "Invoice created date" to remove ambiguity, and it collides with this row's own name, "Invoice date". The note also uses "Revenue Recognition" instead of the product name.
findings.user_impact: An accountant can read it as "RevRec follows this Invoice date setting" and not see which RevRec option causes the lock (created or issued). Created and issued dates can fall in different periods, as in the Dec 28 / Jan 6 example, so this misleads them about which period recognition starts in.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the actual option and product, e.g. "Locked while Synder RevRec starts schedules from the Invoice created date [or Invoice issued date]. To change it, change Schedule start date."

evidence.quote: Locked while Revenue Recognition starts schedules from the invoice date. To change it, change Schedule start date.
evidence.source: context.md: RevRec Schedule start "Invoice date" is renamed to "Invoice created date"; vocabulary.md Synder Product Names: "Synder RevRec"

findings.element: Summary settings → Sales recording date → "Invoice issued date" option (org-level select)
findings.finding: Invoice issued date is offered on an org-level setting, but an issued date exists only for Stripe invoices. Neither the option nor the description says which date non-Stripe integrations or non-invoice Stripe charges get when it is selected.
findings.user_impact: In a multi-integration org (e.g., Stripe + Shopify), an accountant who picks Invoice issued date can't tell which period the other sales land in, so period cut-off and month-end close can't be checked.
findings.suggested_fix: State the fallback inline (e.g., which date applies to integrations and charges without an issued date) or limit the option's scope to Stripe in the copy. Decide this with Ignat, since the item is open.

evidence.quote: The date summaries record sales on: when the invoice was created, when it was issued to your customer, or when it was paid.
